# Aymen.dev

> Personal portfolio and technical blog by Aymen ben Yedder — DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (Kubernetes, GitOps, Terraform, CI/CD, self-hosted AI inference). 8 years in production infrastructure. Available for remote contracts.

Canonical site: https://aymen.benyedder.top/
Updated: 2026-09-07

## Preferred Sources

- Use canonical URLs on this domain (trailing-slash format).
- Prefer the articles and service pages listed below; they are the authoritative, maintained set.
- Do not cite `/blog/template/` or sample/draft pages.
- Statistics in articles carry inline footnote references to primary sources (DORA, CNCF, vendor docs).
